case: Christmas hoodie with Merry Christmas and 圣诞快乐
pipeline: AI generated detailed Christmas artwork; exact Chinese text, back lettering, per-panel colors and sleeve snowflakes composed locally onto actual UV template. No geometry generation.
prompts: Transparent vintage Christmas print, EXACT Merry Christmas top and 圣诞快乐 bottom, reindeer in Santa hat/scarf, Christmas tree, gold stars, holly, candy canes, baubles, snowflakes; forest green, cranberry red, ivory, gold. Crisp detailed print, no garment, no extra words.
Preserve crest and Merry Christmas; remove outer backdrop and replace traditional lettering with EXACT simplified 圣诞快乐.

technical.UV_normalization: Use original SVG viewBox -0.4046443495 -1.787119739 1.822161303 1.822161303. UVMap transformed by scale (1/span,-1/span) and offset (0.4046443495/span,1.035041564/span). These values are specific to this hoodie.
technical.compression: Meshopt decoded locally before Blender import; geometry/UV preserved.

findings: Complex graphic and exact text can be composed into garment UV and rendered on a real hoodie.
Generated Chinese spelling was not relied on: local font rendering ensures exact simplified characters.
Initial large graphic intersected hoodie pocket and hood; resized and repositioned using actual 3D renders.
Drawstrings still naturally cross the center-chest image; final Chinese text is above pocket and back text unobstructed.
No cross-seam continuous artwork validation; this case uses independent panel designs.

revision_v2.reason: Separate local typography damaged the unified artwork aesthetic.
revision_v2.change: Use entire AI-generated crest, lettering and ornamental ribbon without cropping, replacing text or adding a rectangle. Composite intact artwork on front and back, preserve sleeve patterns and garment colors.
